draft.fearless_rules: Hard Fearless: a champion picked by either team in an earlier game of the series is unavailable to both teams for the remaining games of that series. Bans do not carry over (only picks). The pool resets at the start of every new series. Normal snake draft with 10 bans and 10 picks each game via the client Tournament Draft feature. Picking an unavailable champion restarts champ select to the error point; banning an unavailable champion is not remade.
draft.fearless_rules_verdict: CONFIRMED (Riot definition 16/03/2025: 'champions picked in previous games of a best-of-series become unavailable for both teams in subsequent games'; ban reset and series reset from mmorpg.com; error rules from IE ruleset 4.5.6 and 4.5.7)

first_selection.rule: Right of First Selection (RoFS) for Game 1: the holder chooses either pick position or map side; the opponent gets its preference on the other. Play-In R1-R3: coin flip. Play-In R4: the team from the winners' match holds Right of Dual Selection (both side and pick order). Swiss: higher regional seed, coin flip if equal. QF: better Swiss record, QF draw order if equal. SF and Final: coin flip. Games 2+: loser of the previous game holds RoFS.

swiss_pairing.rule: Rounds 2-5: random draw among teams with identical record; no rematches anywhere in Swiss; a drawn team that would create or force a rematch moves to the next slot; officials may waive if no legal draw exists. Round 1: Pool 1 v Pool 4, Pool 2 v Pool 3, no intra-regional match.

swiss_standings_tiebreak.rule: None; advancement is 3 wins, elimination 3 losses. RoFS ties: Swiss by regional seed then coin flip; QF by Swiss record then QF draw order.

qf_draw.rule: Two 3-0 teams randomly paired with two of the three 3-2 teams, placed on opposite halves; remaining four teams (three 3-1 and one 3-2) randomly drawn into two matches, placement by draw order

roster_rules.emergency_sub: Visa issues qualify as a Roster Emergency; eligible subs: contracted players registered before lock (incl. affiliated Tier 2), any player with 0% Tier 1 participation in the active split, registered staff; original player must immediately return when cleared; team forfeits if it cannot field 3 original starters 72 h before its first match
